createdFor: V7 Lane Z second 30 first-party source-bound devotional covers
notes: All prompts are rooted in the exact narrative of 02a-02c original release records; no artwork is made or approved by this file.

entries.scene: On an everyday commuter train, a worried passenger lifts their gaze from an unlit phone toward the ordinary calm of other travelers, grounding attention in what is actually happening.
entries.composition: Eye-level window-side environmental portrait with the passenger's releasing grip and unstaged commuters in soft focus.
entries.lighting: blue-gray rainy morning with warm train interior reflections
entries.altText: A tense train passenger looks up from a phone and notices the calm carriage around them.

entries.scene: A hesitant child at the edge of a public swimming lesson is encouraged by a trusted caregiver beside them; the child takes a small careful step toward the instructor.
entries.composition: Human-scale diagonal view across a shallow pool edge, natural hand placement and reassuring presence, no heroic poses.
entries.lighting: soft diffuse daylight through indoor pool windows
entries.altText: A child takes a small step toward a swim class as a caregiver stands close by.

entries.scene: An older man sits alone on a quiet garden step with eyes closed after an ordinary hard morning, allowing grief to be felt rather than suppressed, hands resting openly on his knees.
entries.composition: Medium side profile framed by everyday courtyard plants, no exaggerated weeping or staged clasped hands.
entries.lighting: gentle cloudy morning with low contrast
entries.altText: An older man sits in an open garden with his eyes closed in honest sorrow.

entries.scene: A mother and her adult son tend a memorial tree planted in a neighborhood garden, gently tying a support stake and remembering someone together without displaying names.
entries.composition: Restrained environmental two-shot with the sapling as the shared task rather than cemetery or spectacle.
entries.lighting: soft early-spring overcast light
entries.altText: A mother and her adult son care for a memorial tree together.

entries.scene: At a city bus shelter just after work, a young adult records a short voice message for a trusted friend, then lowers the phone with a cautious but genuine hopeful expression.
entries.composition: Tight observational side angle showing phone back only, solitary bus stop in context, no screen letters.
entries.lighting: cool blue-hour urban ambient light
entries.altText: A person at a bus stop records a message to reach out to a friend.

entries.scene: During a tense family discussion in a dining room, a woman deliberately lowers her hand and quietly pours water for someone across the table before replying.
entries.composition: Understated documentary medium frame with lowered gesture and glass centered; faces composed, no theatrical argument.
entries.lighting: neutral late-afternoon window daylight
entries.altText: A woman pauses during a difficult family conversation and offers water rather than reacting sharply.

entries.sourceTitle: Tell the truth without becoming cruel
entries.scene: Two coworkers who have experienced a serious breach of trust talk calmly across a small office table, one showing a restrained boundary with the space between their chairs.
entries.composition: Subtle seated two-person profile; empathy and distance coexist; no aggressive pointing, documents unmarked.
entries.lighting: muted after-hours office light
entries.altText: Two coworkers discuss a breach of trust while keeping respectful distance.

entries.scene: After an unsuccessful music audition, a teenager carries a violin case away from a rehearsal building toward a welcoming parent outside, holding upright posture despite disappointment.
entries.composition: Cinematic medium street scene capturing forward movement and meaningful welcome, doors closed in background but no readable posters.
entries.lighting: cloudy autumn afternoon with warm street reflections
entries.altText: A teenager with a violin case walks toward a waiting parent after a disappointing audition.

entries.scene: A young volunteer returns a borrowed toolbox to its owner with one missing part carefully replaced, offering it across a community-workshop counter in quiet accountability.
entries.composition: Hand-height close detail of returned toolbox and sincere eye contact, no words or receipts.
entries.lighting: clear morning workshop sidelight
entries.altText: A volunteer returns a repaired toolbox to its owner to make amends.

entries.scene: A withdrawn young woman opens a dim bedroom curtain to let in daylight while a concerned friend waits just inside the open door with a simple cup of tea.
entries.composition: Observational environmental side shot showing brave opening to support rather than hiding one's face.
entries.lighting: subtle cool morning light entering a dark room
entries.altText: A young woman opens her bedroom curtains while a friend patiently offers tea.

entries.scene: A young dancer practices a humble footwork sequence alone at a quiet neighborhood studio after the audience has left, concentrating on learning instead of applause.
entries.composition: Low side perspective focused on posture and practice, bare neutral studio, no trophies or mirrors showing extra limbs.
entries.lighting: even overhead studio light with gentle window fill
entries.altText: A dancer practices alone for the joy of learning rather than seeking applause.

entries.sourceTitle: Keep the question in the room
entries.scene: A father and teenage daughter sit on opposite ends of a modest living-room sofa, speaking seriously while the daughter holds a blank journal and the father leans in to listen.
entries.composition: Intimate documentary two-shot, open receptive expressions with plenty of calm domestic negative space.
entries.lighting: warm early evening floor lamp and muted windows
entries.altText: A father listens closely while his daughter talks through a difficult question.

entries.scene: A new volunteer at a neighborhood food bank separates one clear crate of food from a crowded supply room as an experienced teammate calmly guides the next practical task.
entries.composition: Wide aisle-level view with the one chosen crate as focal point and stacked supplies as context; avoid any written package labels.
entries.lighting: cool industrial daylight through high windows
entries.altText: A volunteer begins with one manageable food-bank task while a teammate guides them.

entries.sourceTitle: Keep sowing before you see fruit
entries.scene: A teacher patiently guides a struggling child through a simple hands-on science experiment in a nearly empty classroom after school, continuing even before understanding is visible.
entries.composition: Quiet two-person low-angle medium shot with focused teaching gestures, no legible blackboard or worksheets.
entries.lighting: soft late-afternoon classroom window light
entries.altText: A teacher patiently helps a student work through an experiment.

entries.sourceTitle: Call to mind what remains true
entries.scene: A weary mother pins a small handmade paper bird her child gave her to an uncluttered corkboard at home, pausing to recall affection that remains real on a painful day.
entries.composition: Close tactile profile with hands, blank paper bird and a grounded family context, avoid obvious inspirational lettering.
entries.lighting: dim stormy afternoon with one natural window patch
entries.altText: A weary parent pins a handmade bird from her child to a corkboard and pauses to remember love.

entries.scene: At a busy morning street market, an older produce seller organizes one manageable crate from a crowded stall while deliberately leaving other crates for later.
entries.composition: Low environmental perspective with crates in depth and the one active task clearly centered, no advertisements or prices.
entries.lighting: soft market-awning shade
entries.altText: A produce seller organizes a single crate despite many tasks around the stall.

entries.scene: A commuting office worker takes an unnecessary heavy bag off their shoulder on an apartment landing, sorts only necessary items into a small shoulder satchel, and leaves the rest at home.
entries.composition: Natural waist-high side view with the physical act of releasing burdens, no symbolic boulders or staged mindfulness.
entries.lighting: cool evening stairwell and warm apartment doorway
entries.altText: A commuter lightens an overfilled bag before leaving home.

entries.scene: A tired bicycle courier rests in shade beside a parked bike during midday, drinks water and lets their shoulders relax before returning to work.
entries.composition: Photorealistic medium-distance park-side portrait with rest and bodily limits obvious, no mountain destination.
entries.lighting: hard midsummer light softened under urban trees
entries.altText: A bicycle courier takes a needed water break in a shaded park.

entries.scene: At a quiet desk before breakfast, a student keeps a plain notebook open, pausing after writing a single short line whose ink is fully out of focus rather than attempting a long journal.
entries.composition: Intimate top-side editorial shot with intentional one-line action and hands visible, no written text rendered legibly.
entries.lighting: simple overcast morning window light
entries.altText: A student sits with a notebook after writing a short private prayer.

entries.scene: A young adult chooses to leave a noisy late-night gathering early, moving toward a bright apartment stairwell while a group continues socializing behind them.
entries.composition: Cinematic rear-three-quarter frame centered on a decisive walk away, no alcohol brands, no substances, no glamour imagery.
entries.lighting: natural mixed fluorescent stairwell and subdued indoor evening light
entries.altText: A young adult steps away from an uncomfortable late-night gathering.

entries.scene: A volunteer prepares empty chairs one by one for a delayed neighborhood meal, steadily making the room ready instead of staring at the doorway.
entries.composition: Thoughtful low room-level shot with one chair in use, open empty places and clear practical preparation.
entries.lighting: diffused afternoon community-hall light
entries.altText: A volunteer arranges empty chairs to prepare for guests who have not arrived yet.

entries.scene: A younger sibling sincerely gives a small bunch of flowers to an older sister celebrating graduation outside a town hall, choosing connection over comparison.
entries.composition: Candid environmental two-shot with genuine supportive gesture; no diplomas or banners with text.
entries.lighting: mild late-spring cloud-filtered sunlight
entries.altText: One sister congratulates another by giving her a small bouquet.

entries.scene: A carpenter notices a wooden joint does not fit and calmly remeasures the pieces on a workbench before choosing a different tool, keeping the project intact.
entries.composition: Detailed documentary close portrait focused on remeasuring, without anger or danger; distinct from pottery, bikes, or maps.
entries.lighting: daylight from a dusty workshop skylight
entries.altText: A carpenter patiently remeasures wood and adjusts the approach to a difficult joint.

entries.scene: In an ordinary apartment kitchenette, a quiet young adult slices an apple and prepares breakfast despite a flat expression, a modest ritual of keeping life going.
entries.composition: Close environmental framing at counter height, soft human presence, careful anatomy with knife not emphasized.
entries.lighting: muted winter morning light
entries.altText: A tired adult prepares a simple breakfast as part of a steady daily routine.

entries.scene: Two children excitedly show a colorful handmade kite to their grandfather in a neighborhood park, drawing him into their happiness rather than posing for a picture.
entries.composition: Kite in mid-frame but tethered and anatomically credible, natural three-generation interaction, no text.
entries.lighting: bright gentle spring daylight beneath broad trees
entries.altText: Children share the excitement of their handmade kite with their grandfather.

entries.sourceTitle: Trace the gift to the Giver
entries.scene: An adult daughter receives a small basket of homegrown vegetables from her mother at a garden gate, showing warm, specific thanks for the effort and care behind the gift.
entries.composition: Close two-person hands-and-faces scene with soil-stained produce, garden texture and practical tenderness.
entries.lighting: warm but not golden late-morning daylight
entries.altText: A daughter thanks her mother for a basket of vegetables grown in the family garden.

entries.scene: A shopper in a quiet secondhand clothing store decides to keep a well-loved jacket they already own instead of taking an unnecessary new one, neatly placing it back in their bag.
entries.composition: Waist-up observational composition with the existing jacket and choice, no price tags, brand logos or written labels.
entries.lighting: neutral soft store ceiling light
entries.altText: A shopper decides that a familiar jacket is enough and leaves unnecessary shopping behind.

entries.scene: In a rehabilitation gym, a patient carefully practices walking with a mobility aid while a longtime friend follows nearby without overhelping, hopeful progress during a difficult season.
entries.composition: Side-on environmental documentary frame with authentic movement and respect for disability, no melodrama.
entries.lighting: clear midmorning clinical daylight
entries.altText: A person carefully practices walking in rehabilitation with a friend nearby.

entries.scene: Before a youth sports afternoon, an enthusiastic volunteer patiently arranges colorful training cones in a neighborhood field while teammates check equipment behind them.
entries.composition: Low side angle with purposeful athletic preparation, a single dominant action, no sunset or finish-line spectacle.
entries.lighting: soft bright midday outdoor light
entries.altText: An excited volunteer prepares a field for children's sports rather than rushing ahead.

entries.scene: A young adult sets an unlit phone facedown on a public park bench and turns fully toward an elderly mentor who is speaking with emotion, giving patient attention.
entries.composition: Intimate candid side two-shot, clear phone-down-and-listen gesture, simple lived-in city park setting.
entries.lighting: calm cloudy late afternoon
entries.altText: A young adult puts down a phone and listens carefully to an older mentor.
